description: POST /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/logo (multipart/form-data) — uploads a logo from a local file and sets theme.logoUrl to its hosted URL, replacing any previous logo. PNG, WebP or SVG (content-sniffed; scripted SVGs are rejected), at most 2 MiB. The hosted logo is publicly readable. Returns the updated deployment detail. Requires a fresh JWT.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the logo file on this machine. A relative path resolves against the MCP process cwd, not your shell.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

name: yield_deployments_logo_upload
title: Upload a yield deployment logo
